finding: migrate-production.yml is workflow_dispatch-only BY DESIGN: a person types the Neon project id to confirm the target before the write, because a migration applied to the wrong database is worse than no migration. The improvement worth making is a dry run on every schema change (visible in CI, no write), keeping the human confirmation in front of the write.
